description.fallback: Three days later, the Kage discuss the enemy's power and confining the jinchūriki. Tsunade is outraged by confining Naruto and B saying they would help greatly in the war though Gaara and Ōnoki talks her down telling her it was already decided and her sole opinion won't change anything. A says Naruto and B will be confined on an island in Kumogakure that he and B train at.

intro.fallback: Three days later, the Kage discuss the enemy's power and confining the jinchūriki.

Tsunade is outraged by confining Naruto and B saying they would help greatly in the war though Gaara and Ōnoki talks her down telling her it was already decided and her sole opinion won't change anything.
A says Naruto and B will be confined on an island in Kumogakure that he and B train at.

outro.fallback: Naruto tries a rap but messes it up by unintentionally insulting B and tries to fix it with the Harem Technique though B slams the door on Naruto.
Naruto goes to Motoi to ask him how B trained to control the Eight-Tails and shows him to the "Falls of Truth", the first step of how B learned to control his tailed beast.
